uploads.title: The $11B Gas Scam That Almost Broke Nigeria #Shorts

learnings: Use specific, massive dollar amounts in titles (e.g., '$11B') to trigger curiosity.
Focus on 'High-Stakes' outcomes like 'Almost Broke' or 'Total Collapse' to create urgency.
Leverage geopolitical controversy or national scandals to tap into specific regional audiences.
Keep Short titles punchy and front-load the most shocking fact before the hashtag.
Ensure the first 3 seconds visually represent the 'Scam' or 'Loss' mentioned in the title.
Maintain the 'True Crime/Finance' crossover niche as it typically has high CPM and engagement.
Post at least 5-10 Shorts to allow the algorithm to identify the correct seed audience.
double_down: How the oil crisis of the 1970s changed car designs forever.
Why Nigeria's fuel subsidies are a 'billion-dollar trap'.
avoid: Generic automotive reviews without a 'scandal' or 'info' hook.
Vague titles that don't mention a specific country or dollar amount.
Long-form content until a consistent Shorts audience is established.
Passive storytelling; avoid starting videos with 'Hello' or channel introductions.
